guard: independent suite fragments merge without conflict and an existing fragment keeps its shard when another is added
why: Issue #998 has two separable costs. Distinct paths must remove the shared-tail merge conflict,
and fragment assignment must not recreate #983 by depending on sorted directory position.
The first mutation makes both simulated PRs add the same path. The second restores positional
fragment sharding. Each reddens its own named cell through the production registry helper.

mutations.name: simultaneous suite additions share one fragment path again
mutations.expectRed: simultaneous additions on distinct fragment paths merge cleanly with the standard driver
mutations.cell: simultaneous additions on distinct fragment paths merge cleanly with the standard driver

mutations.name: fragment sharding goes back to sorted-position modulo
mutations.expectRed: adding another fragment before it cannot move an existing suite to another shard
mutations.cell: adding another fragment before it cannot move an existing suite to another shard
